ms.report:
Public link to the document with a detailed architecture design that includes the information described in the acceptance criteria above
・https://github.com/catalyst-cardano/smartcontract-automation-testing-framework/blob/main/doc/architecture_design.pdf

I see your comment that says "I do not see Aiken mentioned at all." However, your SoM states "support at least Aiken language." But perhaps we have misunderstood each other's information.
The testing of the Smart contract is conducted through blackbox testing. Our goal is to develop a framework using TypeScript that can support writing test scripts to test smart contracts written in any language, such as Aiken, Haskell, Opshin, etc.
Therefore, I hope you will reconsider your assessment of this comment with regard to our Proof of Achievement.
